content: Microsoft Drivers for PHP for SQL Server 5.13.0 (first GA in 2+ years) adds PHP 8.4/8.5 support; requires PHP 8.3+ and Microsoft ODBC Driver 17 or 18 for SQL Server. Project's PHP 8.2 baseline needs to be bumped to 8.3+ to use the latest driver, or pin to the last driver release supporting 8.2.
